properties.label: exo-face pre-reaction (contact) complex: HCNO stacked over the C4=C5 face on the same side as the C10 methano bridge
properties.geometry: d(C1...C5)=3.59 A, d(O3...C4)=3.26 A, alkene C4=C5=1.34 A; 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest 3 modes -0.7 cm-1, numerical noise)

properties.label: exo-face concerted (asynchronous) 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition saddle point
properties.geometry: C1-C5=2.26 A, O3-C4=2.47 A, C4=C5=1.38 A; dipole syn to the C10 bridge (exo face); single imaginary mode is the coupled C1-C5/O3-C4 formation

properties.label: exo cycloadduct: 2-isoxazoline ring fused cis at C4-C5 and syn to the C10 methano bridge (exo); this is the enantiomer actually reached from the exo saddle. Its mirror image C1=NO[C@@H]2[C@H]3CC[C@H](C3)[C@H]12 (work/gjf/p_exo_optfreq.log, E=-441.098273570 Ha) is formed equally (racemic).
properties.stereo_assignment: RDKit AssignStereochemistryFrom3D on this optimised geometry gives C1=NO[C@H]2[C@@H]3CC[C@@H](C3)[C@@H]12; the isoxazoline ring lies on the same side of the C4-C5-C6-C9 plane as C10 (exo)

properties.label: endo-face pre-reaction (contact) complex: HCNO stacked over the C4=C5 face anti to the C10 methano bridge
properties.geometry: d(C1...C5)=3.59 A, d(O3...C4)=3.26 A, alkene C4=C5=1.34 A; 0 imaginary frequencies
properties.note: the IRC reactant endpoint of the same minimum is -441.020095464 Ha (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0004/reactant_frequency/reactant_frequency.log); the contact conformers differ by 0.46 kcal/mol (endo lower) and are compared separately from the barriers

properties.label: endo-face concerted (asynchronous) 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition saddle point
properties.geometry: C1-C5=2.21 A, O3-C4=2.48 A, C4=C5=1.38 A; dipole anti to the C10 bridge (endo face); IRC (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0004/irc/irc.log) is monotonic in both branches, i.e. no intermediate on this pathway

properties.label: endo cycloadduct: 2-isoxazoline ring fused cis at C4-C5 and anti to the C10 methano bridge (endo); enantiomer C1=NO[C@H]2[C@H]3CC[C@H](C3)[C@@H]12 formed equally
properties.stereo_assignment: RDKit AssignStereochemistryFrom3D on the optimised geometry reproduces this SMILES; identical to the IRC product endpoint (ts/ts_0001/verdict/irc_end_a.xyz)
